 RE: Protest Letter Against Oncor & LCRA TSC Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV Transmission Project (Docket
 59475)

 Dear Chairman Gleeson and Commissioners,

 Thank you for your service to our state and for your continued commitment to protecting Texas communities
 from irresponsible infrastructure projects.

 I am writing today to express my protest against the Bell County East to Big Hill 765k/v transmission project
 proposed by Oncor and LCRA TSC.

 As a resident of Burnet County, I can confirm that this project does not fit our community values. Burnet
 County has intentionally pursued measured, deliberate growth, prioritizing rural character, land stewardship,
 and community over rapid or infrastructure-driven expansion.

 And while this project brings no benefit to our area, it also poses serious rists, and I would like to highlight
 several specific concerns:

     •    Ruination of the scenic and historic Hill Country landscape, which is an irreplaceable part of our
          county's identity.
     •    Proximity to homes, raisingsafety, health and quality of life concerns for families who have built their
          lives here.
     •    Destruction of historic ranches, archaeological sites and valuable cultural resources that help define
          the legacy of our region.
     •    Economic impacts, including decreased property values, reduced county tax revenue and increased
          costs from road degradation during construction.
     •    Safety concerns, including increased wildfire risk and the loss of safe airspace needed for EMS
          helicopter access duringemergencies.

 Given the magnitude of these concerns and the overwhelming lack of public support, I respectfully request
 that you deny any CNN amendment applications forthis project.

 Thank you foryourtime and dedication to our state. I appreciate your consideration and right decision on this
 urgent matter.

 Sincerely,                       , -------       ---
